Reconstruct Per-Block Posterior Covariances for a Group

Source: R/compute_posterior.R
get_sigmak_block.Rd

Calls the real, unchanged (internal) get_sigmak() on each of a group's sub-problem results, collecting one (ID-aligned) covariance matrix per block.

Usage

get_sigmak_block(fit, group)

Arguments

fit

A block_posterior_fit object from fit_block_posterior.

group

Which group's blocks to reconstruct.

Value

A named list of covariance matrices, one per block that group participates in.
